Клюква.about: Cranberries and UTIs: prevention of relapses in women - minus 26%; treatment - no RCT; the effect is limited.
Клюква.caution: Cranberry (Vaccinium macrocarpon). For the prevention of urinary tract infections: Previously considered effective (proanthocyanidins prevent bacterial adhesion), but current meta-analyses show limited effectiveness. For pressure: data are very limited. There is little data (only 2 abstracts in the database).
effects: Recurrence of UTI: −30% in risk groups
Клюква.food_sources: Berries and unsweetened fruit drinks are PAC; store-bought “juice” is diluted - PAC is not enough.
Клюква.guidelines: Cochrane 2023 (50 RCT, 8857): reduces UTI in groups, confidence low. MA 2017 (7, n=1498): RR 0.74. Treatment - no.
Клюква.how_to_choose: Concentrate with PAC ~36 mg/day (juice without sugar); course for relapses; If you have symptoms, see a doctor.
mechs: PACs block E. coli adhesion to the urothelium
Recurrence of UTI: −30% in risk groups
Treatment of bacterial cystitis: no effect (review of dogs and cats, 122 animals)
Клюква.myths: “Treats cystitis” - Cochrane 2023: RCT no. “Prevention for all” - mainly women with relapses. “Any juice” - you need PAC, the fruit drink is diluted.
Клюква.name: Cranberry
Клюква.onset: Course prophylaxis: effect - for months; not “juice for cystitis”; if you have symptoms, call a doctor.
Клюква.title: Cranberry
Клюква.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Клюква.who_needs: Women with recurrent UTIs (RR 0.74)—modest effect; not for treatment and not for the elderly/with a catheter - limited data.
